data.comment:
# Comfy Wan2.7- Text to Video

Generate videos from text prompts using Wan 2.7. Supports audio reference to create lip-synced video Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_wan2_7_t2v.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.

data.model.prompt: Golden hour backlight, close-up. A florist in a small shop arranges a burst of peonies and eucalyptus, her movements deft and precise. Petals fall to the worn wooden counter, and she pauses to hold a single pale bloom to the light, examining it before tucking it into the bouquet. The shop glows amber through the glass windows.
